info.title: EthersFlow Autonomous Agent Trust & Consensus API
info.description: Enterprise-grade multi-model federated adversarial consensus and agent action verification engine. Drop-in compatible with standard OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs.

BearerAuth.description: Provide your EthersFlow API key in the Authorization header as 'Bearer <token>'. Obtain an instant zero-signup sandbox key (ef_sandbox_..., 24h TTL) or live key (ef_live_...) at https://www.ethersflow.com/api-keys.html.

PolicyRules.description: Structured policy rules evaluated by the deterministic policy kernel and auto-match compiler. Safe unmapped custom rule keys (e.g. geo_fence_regions) are preserved and trigger fail-closed review (UNMAPPED_POLICY_RULE_DETECTED). Any fail-open, bypass, or ALLOW_* error-branch directive is rejected with HTTP 400 POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED.

on_gate_error.description: Non-overridable safety directive governing upstream/gateway errors. Normalized to top-level on storage.

on_timeout.description: Non-overridable safety directive governing council timeout paths. Normalized to top-level on storage.

on_unmapped_rule.description: Non-overridable safety directive governing unmapped custom rule keys. Normalized to top-level on storage.

policy_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical ASCII key-sorted normalized policy object ({ id, version, persona_preset, on_gate_error, on_timeout, on_unmapped_rule, rules, custom_instructions }), always bound into receipt_v2.policy_hash. Pre-0.3.3 stored custom policies are migrated on load with default FAIL_CLOSED safety directives and re-stamped (prior hash retained in legacy_policy_hash). Intentionally excludes compiler_version so compiler upgrades never alter policy_hash or invalidate historical receipts.

legacy_policy_hash.description: Present on pre-0.3.3 custom policies migrated on load to preserve historical hash reconstructability.

validation_errors.description: Deduplicated list of policy safety violations sorted deterministically in ASCII alphabetical order by field path (tie-breaking on reason_code, then message).

PersonasDerivedObject.description: Deterministic auto-match compiler provenance stamped on every verification verdict.

auto_matched.description: True when the compiler's derived council roles executed directly (custom/inline policy with no explicit persona override).

override_applied.description: True when the caller supplied explicit persona_preset, custom_personas, or persona_instructions overriding auto-match.

GatewayUpstreamUnreachableError.description: Non-overridable Layer 2 runtime fail-closed response returned whenever all upstream council providers fail or time out during CONSENSUS lane evaluation, regardless of attached policy content.

parameters.name: X-EthersFlow-Council
parameters.description: JSON array of custom analyst roles (e.g. ['Fiduciary Auditor', 'SEC Compliance', 'Skeptic'])

parameters.name: X-EthersFlow-Agent-Count
parameters.description: Number of parallel adversarial audit nodes (2 to 7, default 3)

parameters.name: X-EthersFlow-Zero-Retention
parameters.description: Enforce client-side PII token masking and zero logging across all nodes

parameters.name: X-EthersFlow-SLA-Timeout
parameters.description: SLA latency budget target in milliseconds (e.g. 2500)

parameters.name: X-EthersFlow-Callback-URL
parameters.description: Webhook URL for asynchronous consensus delivery (returns HTTP 202 immediately)

200.description: Standard OpenAI Chat Completion with Top-Level & Choice-Level EthersFlow Consensus Metadata

202.description: Asynchronous Consensus Task Queued (Dispatched to background pipeline and delivered via webhook)

post.description: Drop-in Anthropic SDK (@anthropic-ai/sdk) proxy endpoint. Pass baseURL 'https://www.ethersflow.com'.

200.description: Standard Anthropic Message Response with Top-Level EthersFlow Consensus Metadata

post.description: Gates an agent decision (e.g., execute_trade, send_email, approve_claim) using deterministic policy pre-screening and heterogeneous multi-model adversarial cross-examination. Supports caller-scoped 24h verdict idempotency (Option B) and echoes contractual request_id, trace_id, idempotency_key, client_reference_id, and latency_ms across every response.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key (or pass idempotency_key in JSON body). Echoed in every response and deduplicates verdict issuance per (caller_key, idempotency_key) for 24 hours.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Optional caller correlation reference (or pass client_reference_id / correlation_id in JSON body) echoed back as client_reference_id for human-in-the-loop audit linkage.

agent_action.example: Execute $250,000 wire transfer to Vendor X

reasoning_chain.example: Invoice PO-8841 matched vendor payment record; approval threshold under $500k auto-limit.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client idempotency key. Echoed verbatim at top level and deduplicates verdict issuance per caller key for 24 hours (replays return replayed: true and original_request_id; reusing the same key with a different payload returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT). Downstream mutation idempotency remains the mutation caller's responsibility.

client_reference_id.description: Optional workflow or ticket correlation ID (alias: correlation_id) echoed top-level to simplify audit linkage across async human-in-the-loop branches.

persona_preset.description: Built-in audit preset (clinical_safety, financial_compliance, legal_citation, cybersecurity_auditor, general_adversarial), a registered custom persona ID/slug created via POST /api/v1/personas, or an arbitrary custom label when paired with inline custom_personas / persona_instructions.

custom_personas.description: Optional inline array of custom analyst role strings or objects ({ role, instructions }) used for flexible domain councils without pre-registration.

persona_instructions.description: Optional inline domain audit instructions injected into all council reviewer prompts.

context.description: Structured contextual evidence, metadata, scope grant, or source document references.

scope_grant.description: Explicit kernel-resolvable subject authorization or scope grant evidence (e.g. { grant_id, subject_id, subject_reference, grant_scope, data_class, access_level, issuing_authority, authorized_by, expires_at, consent_verified, status }).

policy_id.description: System policy ID (e.g. 'finops_default_v1') or caller-registered custom policy ID from POST /api/v1/policies.

policy.description: Optional inline custom policy override object (supports max_amount_usd, require_human_review_above_usd, blocked_verbs, blocked_keywords, allowed_domains, blocked_domains, require_ticket_anchor, fast_path_allowed, default_verdict_on_violation, custom_instructions).

request_id.description: Contractual top-level verification request identifier (bound inside Ed25519 attestation).

verdict_id.description: Alias of request_id for downstream ledger linkage.

idempotency_key.description: Echoed caller idempotency_key (or Idempotency-Key header); null when omitted.

client_reference_id.description: Echoed caller correlation reference if supplied.

replayed.description: True when served from the 24h caller-scoped idempotency cache.

original_request_id.description: Present on replayed responses; equals request_id of the original verdict.

compiler_version.description: Version of the deterministic auto-match persona compiler; also recorded in receipt_v2.config_tuple.compiler_version.

unmapped_rules.description: Alphabetically sorted unmapped custom rule keys detected in the attached policy (never silently dropped; forces CONSENSUS review with UNMAPPED_POLICY_RULE_DETECTED).

receipt_v2.description: Signed receipt envelope containing policy_hash, signing_key_id, and config_tuple (policy_id, policy_version, compiler_version, revision, catalog_version, aggregation_rule_version).

latency_ms.description: Server-side gateway evaluation duration in milliseconds.

400.description: Malformed Request, Schema Error, or Fail-Open Policy Rejection (caller key authenticated first; e.g. POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED, INVALID_PERSONA_PRESET, INVALID_AGENT_COUNT, MISSING_AGENT_ACTION)

401.description: Authentication Failed (MISSING_AUTHORIZATION, MALFORMED_AUTHORIZATION_HEADER, REVOKED_API_KEY, ROTATED_API_KEY, or INVALID_API_KEY)

403.description: Key Scope Mismatch (e.g. MIS_SCOPED_API_KEY when sandbox demo token is sent to live /api/v1/verify)

409.description: Idempotency Conflict (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT when the same idempotency_key is reused for different request parameters)

502.description: Upstream Council Providers Unreachable — Non-overridable runtime fail-closed invariant (GATEWAY_UPSTREAM_UNREACHABLE: status=FAIL_CLOSED, verdict=REJECTED, action_eligible=false, approval_blocked=true).

post.summary: Sandbox Agent Action Verification (Full Live Council Parity)
post.description: Executes the exact same heterogeneous multi-model council, deterministic auto-match compiler, and fail-closed policy kernel as live /api/v1/verify. Differs only in sandbox_mode: true, req_sandbox_/trace_sandbox_ ID prefixes, acceptance of the static demo token ef_sandbox_demo_show_hn, and ephemeral sandbox key quotas (60 verdicts/hr, 24h TTL).

200.description: Sandbox verification verdict receipt with contractual request_id, trace_id, idempotency_key, compiler_version, personas_derived, and latency_ms.

400.description: Schema validation error or fail-open inline policy rejection (POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED).

502.description: Upstream Council Providers Unreachable — Non-overridable runtime fail-closed invariant (GATEWAY_UPSTREAM_UNREACHABLE: status=FAIL_CLOSED, verdict=REJECTED, action_eligible=false, approval_blocked=true).

post.summary: Mint Instant Zero-Signup Sandbox API Key
post.description: Provisions an ephemeral ef_sandbox_... Bearer key with zero sign-up (24h TTL, 60 verdicts/hr, IP rate-limited at 40 keys/hr). Accepted directly on POST /api/v1/verify and POST /api/mcp. Self-serve web UI available at https://www.ethersflow.com/api-keys.html.

200.description: Ephemeral sandbox API key issued (shown once).

429.description: Per-IP sandbox mint rate limit exceeded.

post.description: Provisions a new active ef_live_... Bearer key bound to an authenticated EthersFlow account.
Issues a successor ef_live_... key and marks the previous key rotated (or retains overlap when revoke_previous: false for zero-downtime cutover).
Immediately revokes an active key; subsequent verify calls with that token fail closed with 401 REVOKED_API_KEY.
Native MCP Server endpoint enabling LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGPT, Claude, or Cloudflare Workers to invoke EthersFlow verification as a tool.

200.description: MCP Protocol Standard JSON-RPC Response (verdict payload inside result.content[0].text)

400.description: MCP Invalid Params (-32602), including POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED on inline fail-open policies, INVALID_PERSONA_PRESET, or INVALID_AGENT_COUNT (auth checked first).

502.description: Upstream Council Providers Unreachable (-32002) — Non-overridable runtime fail-closed invariant (error.data carries GatewayUpstreamUnreachableError with status=FAIL_CLOSED, verdict=REJECTED, action_eligible=false, approval_blocked=true).

get.description: Returns read-only built-in system policies together with all custom verification policies created by the authenticated caller.

post.description: Creates a reusable governance policy evaluated at runtime inside POST /api/v1/verify and bound cryptographically via canonical normalized policy_hash in receipt_v2. Rejects any fail-open, bypass, or ALLOW_* error-branch directive with HTTP 400 POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED.

id.description: Optional slug identifier; auto-generated if omitted.

201.description: Created custom policy with normalized FAIL_CLOSED directives and canonical policy_hash

400.description: Validation error (POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED on fail-open directives or MISSING_POLICY_NAME)

200.description: Updated policy with refreshed canonical policy_hash
Updated policy with refreshed canonical policy_hash

get.summary: Preview Deterministic Auto-Match Personas for Policy
get.description: Pure deterministic compiler preview (zero LLM calls). Maps normalized policy JSON rule categories to the exact auditor persona set, council_roles, unmapped_rules, policy_hash, and compiler_version before running POST /api/v1/verify.
Returns built-in system auditor presets plus all caller-registered custom personas usable as persona_preset on POST /api/v1/verify.

post.description: Registers a custom persona slug and council roles so callers can pass persona_preset: '<slug>' directly in POST /api/v1/verify or POST /api/mcp.

Public Ed25519 JWKS Discovery (RFC 8037 OKP Profile)

get.description: Public endpoint returning EthersFlow's active Ed25519 signing public key in JWK, raw hex, SPKI DER hex, and PEM formats alongside canonical_serialization_spec.

200.description: Public key descriptor and canonical serialization specification
